summary: Workforce Management Analyst or Real-Time Analyst (RTA) role ensuring optimal staffing levels, maximizing efficiency, and maintaining service levels across the team.
responsibilities: Monitor real-time performance metrics for the team to ensure KPIs are met (e.g., service levels, adherence, handle time).
Use WFM tools (e.g., Genesys, Verint, Aspect, NICE) to track agent activity and make adjustments as needed.
Provide immediate support and troubleshooting for any performance deviations or system errors.
Escalate critical issues to team leaders or management when service levels are at risk.
Make real-time adjustments to agent schedules, shift changes, or breaks to optimize service levels.
Manage exceptions, including absenteeism, tardiness, and emergency leaves, and quickly adjust resources to minimize disruption.
Work closely with team leads, supervisors, and HR to ensure workforce strategies align with business goals.
Communicate real-time performance updates and issues with management and other stakeholders.
Liaise with training and quality teams to ensure agents are adequately prepared to meet targets.
Develop schedules that ensure sufficient coverage while minimizing idle time.
required_skills: Proficient in Microsoft Excel, with the ability to analyze and manipulate large sets of data (advanced formulas, pivot tables, etc.).
Familiarity with WFM software, scheduling tools, and reporting platforms.
Strong knowledge of workforce management principles, including forecasting, scheduling, and adherence monitoring.
nice_to_have_skills: Experience with WFM tools (e.g., NICE, Verint, Aspect, Genesys, etc.) is a plus.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Statistics, Operations, or related field (preferred).
2+ years of experience in Workforce Management, Real-Time Analysis, or a related role (ideally in a contact center or similar environment)
